mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM zentide_change WHERE change_id=#{changeId} AND status='PUBLISHED' AND verification_status='VERIFIED'

SELECT d.*, '社区成员' AS author_label FROM zentide_change_discussion d JOIN zentide_change c ON c.change_id=d.change_id AND c.status='PUBLISHED' AND c.verification_status='VERIFIED' WHERE d.change_id=#{changeId} AND d.status='PUBLISHED' ORDER BY COALESCE(d.parent_discussion_id,d.discussion_id), d.parent_discussion_id IS NOT NULL, d.created_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM zentide_change_discussion WHERE discussion_id=#{discussionId} AND change_id=#{changeId} AND status='PUBLISHED' LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM zentide_evidence e JOIN zentide_change c ON c.change_id=e.change_id WHERE e.evidence_id=#{evidenceId} AND e.change_id=#{changeId} AND c.status='PUBLISHED' AND c.verification_status='VERIFIED'
mapper.update: UPDATE zentide_change_discussion SET status='REMOVED' WHERE discussion_id=#{discussionId} AND author_id=#{authorId} AND status='PUBLISHED'
